name: smells_like_max_verstappen
description:
Feeling the pressure? Like the entire F1 grid is bearing down on you? Then you need our "Smells Like Max Verstappen Simply Lovely" candle, because like Max you'll be able to eat pressure for breakfast!

A great gift for the Formula 1 fans in your life, this candle is a pit stop for emotional refueling.  Light it up, inhale the intoxicating aroma, and visualize yourself effortlessly lapping the competition - be it deadlines, drama, or that particularly stubborn stain on your favorite shirt.  Because sometimes the best way to cope with life's speed bumps is with a little bit of luxurious, witty self-care, and a fragrance that smells simply lovely.  (Results may vary.  Does not actually guarantee F1 championship wins.)
